일요일.x: On Sundays I rest at home.

후.forms: noun + 후에 (수업 후에) · verb + -(으)ㄴ 후에 (먹은 후에)
후.x: Let's have lunch together after class.
후.e: Goes after the time or noun: 수업 후 = after class.
후.t: With time spans: 한 시간 후에 = in one hour (one hour later). 뒤에 is a native synonym.

별.x: In the countryside you can see the stars well at night.
별.e: 별 다섯 개 = five stars (a rating). Unrelated to 별로 (not really).

도.forms: same after consonant or vowel: 저도, 책도 · replaces 은/는, 이/가, 을/를
도.t: 도 replaces subject/object particles: say 저도, not 저는도. But it follows 에/에서: 학교에도.

도.forms: Sino number + 도: 삼십 도, 영하 오 도
도.ex: 오늘 서울 기온은 삼십 도까지 올라가요.
도.x: Today the temperature in Seoul will go up to 30 degrees.
도.e: Korea uses Celsius: 30도 is hot, and 0도 is freezing.
도.t: Read it with Sino-Korean numbers: 이십 도 for 20 degrees, never with native numbers.

답답하다.ex: 말이 잘 안 통해서 너무 답답해요.
답답하다.x: I can't get my point across, so it's really frustrating.
답답하다.e: Works for a stuffy room and a stuffed-up, frustrated heart — think 'I can't breathe'.
답답하다.t: Pronounced [답따파다]: the second ㄷ tenses, and ㅂ + ㅎ becomes ㅍ.

신나다.m: to be excited, to have a blast
신나다.x: The kids see the snow and run around excitedly.
신나다.e: 신 'high spirits' + 나다 'to come out': excitement bubbling out.

누르다.forms: 눌러요 · 눌렀어요 · 누를 거예요 · 누르세요 (르 irregular)
누르다.x: If you press this button, the door opens.
누르다.e: Same root as 눌리다 'to be pressed'; the 르 turns into ㄹㄹ before -어.
누르다.t: Online, 좋아요를 누르다 means to hit 'Like'.

남기다.x: Don't leave any food; please eat it all.
남기다.e: 남다 'to remain' + causative -기-: 'to make something remain'.
남기다.t: Also used for messages: 메시지를 남기다 'to leave a message'.

흔들다.forms: 흔들어요 · 흔들었어요 · 흔들 거예요 · 흔드세요 (ㄹ drops)
흔들다.ex: 친구가 저를 보고 멀리서 손을 흔들었어요.
흔들다.x: My friend saw me and waved from far away.
흔들다.e: Passive 흔들리다 means 'to shake, sway': 배가 흔들려요.

손수건.x: I was sweating, so I wiped my face with a handkerchief.

있잖아요.forms: casual: 있잖아 · polite: 있잖아요 · 저기, 있잖아요…
있잖아요.m: you know, …; listen, … (bringing up a topic)
있잖아요.x: You know what? I'm getting married next month.
있잖아요.e: 있다 'to exist' + -잖아요 'you know': literally 'there's (this thing), you know'.
있잖아요.t: Pronounced [읻짜나요]. Grabs attention before news or a delicate topic, or reminds: 그 카페 있잖아요, 거기서 만나요.
rel: to be, to exist; to have

토하다.ex: 어제 술을 너무 많이 마셔서 토했어요.
토하다.x: I drank way too much yesterday and threw up.

떡국.ex: 한국 사람들은 설날 아침에 떡국을 먹어요.
떡국.x: Koreans eat rice cake soup on Lunar New Year's morning.
떡국.e: 떡 'rice cake' + 국 'soup'; eating it on New Year's means you turn a year older.
떡국.t: 떡국 몇 그릇 먹었어요? ('How many bowls of 떡국 have you eaten?') is a playful way to ask someone's age.

줄이다.m: to reduce, to cut down, to decrease; to shorten
줄이다.x: I'm cutting down on sugar for my health.
줄이다.e: Causative of 줄다 'to decrease': to make something decrease.

자연 보호.ex: 자연 보호를 위해 쓰레기를 줄여야 해요.
자연 보호.x: We need to reduce trash to protect nature.

수의사.x: My puppy was sick, so I took it to the local vet.

입장하다.m: to enter (a venue), to be admitted
입장하다.ex: 공연 시작 30분 전부터 입장할 수 있습니다.
입장하다.x: You can enter starting 30 minutes before the show.
입장하다.e: Literally 'enter the venue'; a homonym 입장 means 'position, standpoint'.

가꾸다.m: to grow, tend (plants, a garden); to take care of (one's looks)
가꾸다.x: My grandmother grows flowers and vegetables in the yard.

명상.ex: 자기 전에 십 분씩 명상을 하면 마음이 편해져요.
명상.x: If I meditate for ten minutes before bed, my mind feels at ease.
명상.e: Literally 'deep thinking': 冥 'dark, deep' + 想 'thought'.

업적.ex: 그는 회사를 위해 큰 업적을 남겼어요.
업적.x: He left behind great achievements for the company.
업적.t: Pronounced [업쩍] — the ㅈ is tensed after ㅂ.

주치의.ex: 주치의 선생님이 수술 결과를 설명해 주셨어요.
주치의.x: My attending doctor explained the results of the surgery.

오케스트라.ex: 주말에 오케스트라 공연을 보러 갈 거예요.
오케스트라.x: I'm going to see an orchestra performance this weekend.
오케스트라.e: From English 'orchestra'; each consonant cluster gets its own ㅡ vowel.

외로움.ex: 혼자 외국에서 살 때 외로움을 많이 느꼈어요.
외로움.x: I felt very lonely when I lived abroad by myself.
외로움.e: Noun from 외롭다 (to be lonely); the ㅂ becomes 우.
외로움.t: Collocation: 외로움을 타다 = to be prone to loneliness, to get lonely easily.

동정.x: I don't need pity; I need help.
동정.e: Literally 'same feeling' — feeling what another person feels.
동정.t: Common pattern: 동정을 받다 'to receive pity' vs. 동정심 'a sense of compassion'.

간간이.forms: 간간이 + verb (비가 간간이 내리다); ≈ 가끔, 때때로
간간이.m: now and then, occasionally; here and there
간간이.x: Now and then, I can hear birds singing outside the window.
간간이.e: Literally 'interval after interval' plus adverb ending -이: things happening with gaps in between.

확정되다.m: to be confirmed, to be finalized
확정되다.x: The date of the next meeting was confirmed for Friday.
확정되다.t: Pronounced [확쩡되다] — the ㅈ becomes tense after ㄱ.

처지다.m: to sag, droop; to fall behind; to feel down
처지다.x: As I got older, my eyelids drooped a little.
처지다.e: Homonym warning: the noun 처지 'situation, circumstances' is a different word.

귀에 못이 박히다.forms: 귀에 못이 박히도록 들어요 · 귀에 못이 박히도록 들었어요
귀에 못이 박히다.m: to hear something over and over, to be told a million times
귀에 못이 박히다.ex: 공부하라는 말은 귀에 못이 박히도록 들었어요.
귀에 못이 박히다.x: I've been told to study a million times.
귀에 못이 박히다.e: This 못 is a callus, not a nail: hearing something constantly gives your ears calluses.
귀에 못이 박히다.t: Almost always used as 귀에 못이 박히도록 (or 박히게) + 듣다/말하다.

인지도.x: Thanks to advertising, brand awareness went up.
인지도.e: Literally 'degree of being known'. -도 = degree: 만족도, 인기도.

누그러지다.m: to soften, to ease, to calm down
누그러지다.ex: 사과를 받고 나서야 그의 화가 조금 누그러졌어요.
누그러지다.x: Only after receiving an apology did his anger soften a little.
누그러지다.e: Probably related to 눅다 'to be soft, mild' plus -어지다 'become'.

앞지르다.forms: 앞질러요 · 앞질렀어요 · 앞지를 거예요 · 앞지르세요 (르 irregular)
앞지르다.m: to overtake, to outrun, to get ahead of
앞지르다.ex: 마지막 바퀴에서 그 선수가 선두를 앞질렀어요.
앞지르다.x: On the final lap, that athlete overtook the leader.
앞지르다.e: Built from 앞 'front' plus 지르다 'to cut across.'

누누이.ex: 선생님께서 누누이 강조하신 부분이 시험에 나왔어요.
누누이.x: The part the teacher stressed over and over came up on the test.
누누이.e: 'Again and again' doubled, plus the adverb ending -이.
누누이.t: Almost always used with speech verbs: 누누이 말하다, 강조하다, 당부하다.

허물없이.m: casually, without reserve, like close friends
허물없이.ex: 우리는 어릴 때부터 허물없이 지낸 친구예요.
허물없이.x: We're friends who've been completely at ease with each other since childhood.
허물없이.e: Built from 허물 'fault, flaw' plus 없이 — so close that flaws don't matter.
허물없이.t: Pronounced [허무럽씨]; 허물 also means a shed skin, as in 뱀 허물.

여지없이.x: His prediction completely missed the mark once again.
여지없이.e: Literally 'with no leftover ground' — no room left at all.

엄살을 부리다.forms: 엄살을 부려요 · 엄살을 부렸어요 · 엄살 부리지 마
엄살을 부리다.m: to exaggerate pain or hardship; to make a fuss
엄살을 부리다.x: It's just a little scratch, but my brother is making a big fuss.
엄살을 부리다.t: 엄살이 심하다 = to be a big baby about pain.

중립.x: The press should remain politically neutral.
중립.t: Pronounced [중닙] — ㄹ after ㅇ becomes ㄴ.

접경.ex: 이 마을은 중국과의 접경 지역에 있습니다.
접경.x: This village is in an area bordering China.

황송하다.m: to be humbled, overwhelmed with gratitude (by undeserved kindness)
황송하다.x: I'm truly humbled that you would give me such a precious gift.
황송하다.e: Literally 'awed and fearful' — overwhelmed by a superior's kindness.
황송하다.t: Used toward elders or superiors; 황송하다 mixes gratitude with feeling unworthy.
rel: to be more than one deserves

커튼콜.ex: 공연이 끝나자 관객들의 박수 속에 커튼콜이 이어졌어요.
커튼콜.x: When the show ended, curtain calls followed amid the audience's applause.

장악하다.m: to seize control of, to take over, to dominate
장악하다.ex: 그 회사는 국내 시장을 빠르게 장악했어요.
장악하다.x: The company quickly took over the domestic market.
장악하다.e: Literally 'grasp in the palm' — holding something firmly in hand.

한사코.ex: 친구는 돈을 받지 않겠다고 한사코 거절했어요.
한사코.x: My friend stubbornly refused to take the money.
한사코.e: Literally 'to the limit of death': resisting with all one's might.

박정하다.ex: 어려울 때 도와주지 않다니 너무 박정해요.
박정하다.x: Not helping me when I was struggling is so heartless.
박정하다.t: Often 박정하게 굴다 'to treat someone coldly'; the opposite is 다정하다.

숙성하다.ex: 그 아이는 나이에 비해 생각이 무척 숙성해요.
숙성하다.x: That child thinks in a very mature way for her age.
숙성하다.t: Homonym: 숙성 'aging, fermenting', as in 숙성된 김치 or 고기, is far more common.

정정하다.m: hale and hearty (of an elderly person)
정정하다.x: Grandpa is over ninety but still very hale and hearty.
정정하다.e: From hanja describing a tree standing tall and straight.
정정하다.t: Used only for older people; homonym 정정하다 (訂正) is a verb meaning 'to correct'.

가처분.ex: 법원은 공사 중지 가처분 신청을 받아들였습니다.
가처분.x: The court granted the application for an injunction to halt construction.
가처분.e: Literally 'temporary disposition' — a court freezes things until the main ruling.
가처분.t: Common in news as 가처분 신청 'filing for an injunction' and 가처분 인용 'granting it.'
